title: MPIC closes P12.4-B Meralco share acquisition

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Pangilinan-led Metro Pacific Investments Corp. (MPIC) has strengthened its grip on Manila Electric Co. (Meralco) after completing a P12.4-billion acquisition of an additional stake from tycoon Ramon Ang. In a disclosure on Friday, Ang-led San Miguel Corp. said its energy arm, San Miguel Global Power Holdings Corp. (SMGP), had already completed the sale of 21.4 million common shares in Meralco to MPIC. READ: MPIC raises stake in Meralco with P12.4-B San Miguel deal The shares crossed through the Philippine Stock Exchange on Thursday.
